Name: Lumisteria-  Alternative Textures - Grass - Short
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. See beautiful grass variations with seasons, choose which ones to use with Paint Bucket and Paint Brush (Alternative Textures tools). You can then use them to create patterns if you like, or make themed patch of grass for decorating purpose. Or don't use tools and just enjoy the randomness.

This pack contains variations for all seasons.

The difference between AT and More Grass is mainly in the ability for AT to use tools to change the way grass looks.

If you want to make big decors of grass and not have animals eating grass, consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7474]Animals Don't Eat Grass[/url].
